data.one_liner: Provides Dart APIs to control macOS NSWindow properties and behavior.
data.what_it_does: The plugin lets Flutter apps modify the macOS window—size, title bar, transparency, toolbar, and button visibility. It also offers delegate callbacks for window events.
use_when: You need fine‑grained control over a macOS app window
You want to hide the title bar or make the window transparent
You need to react to window events like resize or fullscreen
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than macOS
You only need cross‑platform window handling
strengths: Simple Dart‑only calls for native features
Includes example project and widgets for safe area handling
weaknesses: Requires native Xcode configuration and deployment‑target changes
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin, then open macOS Runner.xcworkspace, set Deployment Target ≥10.14.6, and adjust Podfile platform line. Call WindowManipulator.initialize() before runApp().
